# Master data (PPG & eCommerce)

## Purpose

**Master data** menu entries support merchandising and e-commerce content around **PPG** (price/product groups) and descriptions — not full mass-load, but guided maintenance screens.

## Who may use it

**Buyer** and **Space planning** flags.

## Screens

| Screen | Route | Purpose |
|--------|-------|---------|
| Retail by PPG | `/ppgretail` | Retail price maintenance by PPG |
| Next PPG | `/nextppg` | Upcoming PPG transitions |
| eCommerce desc | `/ecommdesc` | eCommerce description maintenance |
